backend: Existing VKF JavaScript browser physics reference; not a newly compiled native/WASM/GPU physics engine
gameAdapter: physics.mjs: stable object IDs, analytic circles, CSS-pixel coordinates, mass=r^2, zero gravity, restitution=1, friction=0, sleep disabled; held object is kinematic
ownership: VKF owns integration, contact geometry, constraints and impulses. Game owns mathematical compatibility, gesture targets and merge choreography.
